title: WaSA: Wavelet Scattering Autoencoders for Unsupervised Offline Detection of Malicious Clients in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13186v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without exposing raw data, yet remains vulnerable to malicious clients injecting poisoned datasets. Existing defenses are typically reactive (operating during training) or supervised (requiring prior knowledge of attack types) - assumptions that rarely hold in open-ended IoT deployments. We propose WaSA, a fully unsupervised, offline framework for malicious client detection. Before training, each client transmits a single, privacy-preserving spectral summary of its data to the server. A denoising autoencoder, trained solely on clean auxiliary data, scores clients based on their deviation from the learned benign manifold, identifying corruptions regardless of the attack type. WaSA requires no attack labels, generalizes to unseen anomalies, and introduces a Boltzmann sampling strategy for client selection that smoothly interpolates between hard exclusion and standard aggregation.

translated_title: WaSA：用于联邦学习中恶意客户端无监督离线检测的小波散射自编码器
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）能够在不暴露原始数据的情况下实现协作模型训练，但仍然容易受到注入中毒数据集的恶意客户端的攻击。现有的防御方法通常是被动的（在训练过程中运行）或监督式的（需要预先了解攻击类型）——这些假设在开放式物联网部署中很少成立。我们提出了WaSA，这是一个完全无监督的恶意客户端离线检测框架。在训练之前，每个客户端向服务器传输一份单一的、保护隐私的数据频谱摘要。一个仅使用干净辅助数据训练的去噪自编码器，根据客户端与所学习的良性流形的偏差对其进行评分，无论攻击类型如何都能识别数据损坏。WaSA不需要攻击标签，能够泛化到未见过的异常，并引入了一种用于客户端选择的玻尔兹曼采样策略，可以在硬排除和标准聚合之间平滑插值。
tldr: 提出了完全无监督的离线检测框架WaSA，通过小波散射自编码器对客户端数据频谱摘要进行评分，无需攻击标签即可识别任意类型的联邦学习投毒攻击。
en_tdlr: WaSA is a fully unsupervised offline framework that uses wavelet scattering autoencoders to score clients' spectral summaries, detecting poisoning attacks of any type in federated learning without requiring attack labels.
